items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Elmer didn't want to go on the road, because he always told me -- he say, 'You are my next tenor player.' ... if Elmer leave or something like that, you got his job.

ctx.x: That was the guy, the leader -- directing Chick's band. "Hey, man, Chick told me you was back in town. Chick wanna see you.
I say, "Wanna see me?" He say, "Elmer Williams don't want to leave to go on the road." This is that hard year, '36 -- the summer of '36 -- April.
He says, "Come on over. Chick's down at the Brickwood," cross the street from a famous little club downstairs.
